name: Fibre-Reinforced Composites: Mechanics & Manufacturing
summary: Goes deep into laminate analysis, damage tolerance and manufacturing of advanced fibre composites such as the CFRP used in modern aircraft and rockets.

topics.name: Carbon-fibre manufacture: PAN and pitch precursors, stabilisation, carbonisation and graphitisation
Anisotropic elasticity of a lamina: compliance and stiffness matrices
Classical laminate theory: ABD matrix, coupling and symmetric/balanced laminates
Hygrothermal stresses and residual stresses in laminates
Lamina failure criteria: maximum stress, Tsai-Hill, Tsai-Wu, Hashin and Puck
Progressive damage: matrix cracking, delamination and fibre failure
Impact damage and compression-after-impact (CAI); damage-tolerant design
Fatigue and environmental durability of composites
Manufacturing: prepreg lay-up and autoclave curing, out-of-autoclave processes
Liquid moulding (RTM, VARTM, infusion), filament winding and pultrusion
Automated fibre placement and tape laying; thermoplastic composites and welding
Defects: porosity, wrinkles and fibre misalignment; NDI of composites
Joining composites: bonded and bolted joints
Composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) and cryogenic composite tanks
